tools.name: get_validation
tools.description: The status and result of a validation started with validate_xml that was still running when it returned (status "queued" or "running"). Results are kept for 24 hours.

tools.name: search_schemas
tools.description: Search xmlvalid's catalog of official XML schemas (UBL, CII, Peppol, XRechnung, Factur-X, ISO 20022, HL7, sitemaps…) by name, namespace, root element or area. Returns each schema's slug to pass to validate_xml, its version and the business rules it checks. No API key needed.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Explain an XML parsing or schema validation error message: what it means, why it happens and how to fix it, with an example. tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Explain an e-invoicing business rule by its id, such as BR-CO-15, BR-DE-1, PEPPOL-EN16931-R001 or a national CIUS rule: its message, level, the rule sets it belongs to, why invoices fail it and how to fix them. No API key needed.
